title: A dispersive extension result for a class of nonlocal nonlinearities
summary: We prove that a class of nonlocal nonlinearities on periodic Sobolev spaces can be expressed as a trace of the unique mild solution to a local dispersive problem consisting of a system of forced Schrödinger equations. The proof is based on a reformulation of the nonlocal nonlinearities as the resonant orbit average of a real-analytic function under the unitary group generated by the free Schrödinger operator $\mathrm{i} \partial_x^2$.
